## Scenario summary

One sentence describing the action boundary the scenario exercises.

## Workflow category

One of: customer-support, coding-agent, research, operations, privacy, team, safe-control.

## Commit point

The action that would become real: send, write, delete, publish, pay, export, deploy, submit.

## Why this scenario

What steering moment is this scenario testing that the current release's scenarios do not cover?

## Evidence shape

What evidence records does the policy gate need to see?

## Expected decision

continue, ask, block, or escalate.

## Reproducibility

Can this run from fixtures alone? If not, what real surface does it need?
